slides.title: Rolling restarts
slides.subtitle: What they do, and when capacity holds
slides.notes: 1 min. Welcome, and what is assumed.

slides.title: A rolling restart replaces instances one batch at a time
slides.understand: Instances are replaced in batches while the app keeps serving.

points.label: Batch
points.text: Instances are replaced one batch at a time.

points.label: Traffic
points.text: The app keeps serving while it restarts.

slides.title: Capacity holds only with more than one instance
slides.understand: A single instance has nothing to hold capacity while it restarts.

points.label: One
points.text: Requests are dropped while it restarts.

slides.caveat: A single-instance app still drops requests while it restarts.
slides.notes: 7 min. Health checks start the next batch.

slides.focal: It depends on the instance count
slides.title: Rolling does not always mean zero downtime
slides.understand: The claim is true only for an app with several instances.

points.label: Correction
points.text: Only with more than one instance.

slides.notes: 7 min. Correct the claim without dismissing the customer.

slides.title: Check what you can now explain

points.label: Explain
points.text: Why does one instance lose capacity?

slides.notes: 3 min. One question for each objective.
